info.name: Massive.com Market Data API
info.description: Massive.com (formerly Polygon.io) REST API examples covering every documented REST endpoint. Auth is a Bearer header from the `MASSIVE_API_KEY` environment variable; the key never goes in URLs. Each request description notes the minimum plan. Run '0. Smoke test' first.

exec: // Fill {{from}}, {{to}}, {{date}} automatically unless you set them in the environment.
if (!get("from")) { const d = lastWeekday(); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - 30); pm.variables.set("from", fmt(d)); }
if (!get("MASSIVE_API_KEY")) console.warn("MASSIVE_API_KEY is empty: select the 'Massive' environment and set it.");
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test("status is OK or DELAYED", () => pm.expect(["OK", "DELAYED"]).to.include(body.status));
if (code === 401) console.warn("401: check MASSIVE_API_KEY in the environment.");
if (code === 403) console.warn("403 NOT_AUTHORIZED: your plan does not include this endpoint, recency, or history. The key is not broken.");
if (code === 429) console.warn("429: rate limited (free plan is about 5 calls/min). Wait a minute.");
if (code === 400) console.warn("400: a parameter is invalid. Check the request description and the endpoint docs.");
if (code === 404) console.warn("404: unknown ticker or contract. Option/futures contracts expire: refresh optionTicker / futuresTicker.");
console.log("More pages: run '13. Pagination > Follow next_url'.");
